question: Jagoi is a major style of which of the following forms of Indian classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jagoi is a major style of Manipuri, which is one of the forms of Indian classical dance.**
 
• **Manipuri dance** originated in the northeastern state of Manipur and is known for its graceful movements, delicate hand gestures, and vibrant costumes.
 
• **Jagoi is a traditional dance form within Manipuri,** characterized by **rhythmic footwork, expressive facial expressions, and storytelling elements.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya dance **has gained recognition and popularity beyond the confines of the Sattras and Assam.

 
 
• It has evolved as a stage performance art and has been performed at various national and international platforms, showcasing its rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Kathak **is one of the major classical dance forms of India, originating in the northern part of the country, particularly in the states of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
 
 
• It is a vibrant and expressive dance form known for its intricate footwork, graceful movements, and storytelling through mime and gestures.
 
• The word "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Katha," which means story.
 
 
 
• **Odissi** is one of the classical dance forms of **India**, originating in the state of **Odisha**, located in the eastern part of the country.
 
 
• It is one of the oldest surviving dance forms in India with its roots dating back to ancient times, specifically to the temples of Odisha.
